transformations.title: Copper Revival
transformations.before_alt: Before hair transformation showing long hair with dark regrowth and uneven warm copper-orange lengths.
transformations.after_alt: After hair transformation showing a polished shoulder-length copper auburn style with soft waves.
transformations.caption: From uneven warm tones to a polished copper finish with a refreshed shape and soft waves.
transformations.description: A four-asset before-and-after case documenting a visible hair transformation across still photography and motion. The result shows a more consistent copper-auburn tone, refreshed length and shape, added shine, and a styled wave finish.
transformations.lighting_note: Before and after were captured under different lighting and backgrounds; public copy should describe visible changes without overstating treatment effects.
